UserProfile.title: UserProfile
UserProfile.description: Authenticated orchard user profile identified by Firebase Auth UID.

uid.description: Firebase Authentication UID matching the document ID.

email.description: Verified email address of the signed-in user.

displayName.description: Display name shown in the orchard interface.

role.description: Access role assigned to the user profile.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the user profile was created.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the last profile update.

OrchardWorkspace.title: OrchardWorkspace
OrchardWorkspace.description: Complete orchard field-notebook workspace owned by an authenticated user.

ownerId.description: Firebase Auth UID of the orchard owner.

stateData.description: Native Firestore Map containing orchard blocks, labors, inventory, irrigation, well logs, and agronomy records.

createdAt.description: Server timestamp when the orchard workspace was initialized.

updatedAt.description: Server timestamp of the latest orchard synchronization.

/users/{userId}.description: Private user profile metadata strictly isolated per authenticated owner.

/orchards/{userId}.description: Orchard workspace document strictly isolated per authenticated owner.
